t: This is the Broadway Theatre in Deptford, in Lewisham, a former theatre and cinema. It was designed by W. G. R. Sprague, a theatre architect who trained under Frank Matcham before setting up his own practice. Between 1890 and 1929 he designed at least thirty-five theatres. Of his surviving London theatres, eleven are Listed, which means officially recognised as having special architectural or historic interest. So this building is the work of one of the busiest theatre designers of his day.
